title: Special Bob-bit is false with probability two-thirds
statement: Fix a positive integer $n$, and draw a point of the hard-distribution sample space uniformly at random, then condition on the event that Alice's and Bob's generated input sets are disjoint. Under this conditional distribution, the probability that Bob's bit at the special coordinate $T$ equals $\mathrm{false}$ is exactly $2/3$.
hypotheses_covered: distribution is the uniform hard distribution conditioned on the disjointness event
measured event is that Bob's special-coordinate bit specialY is false
replaced: Under the disjoint-conditioned hard distribution, $Y_{T}=false$ has mass $2 / 3$.
